title: GBPUSD M30 Hard Target Equalization (InpTP2Pips=15.0) to Establish 1:1 R:R Symmetry
research_question: Does reducing InpTP2Pips from 30.0 to 15.0 pips (equalizing the hard broker Take Profit with InpTP1Pips=15.0 and InpMaxSLPips=15.0) eliminate the runner drag, raising average win payout to ~$100 (1:1 R:R) and driving 2026 UNSEEN net profit from -$459.09 to strongly positive (> +$1,000.00)?
hypothesis: Because 2026 swings reverse before reaching the 30-pip TP2 target, leaving runners to be stopped out near breakeven while full losses absorb 100% volume at -15 pips, reducing InpTP2Pips from 30.0 to 15.0 will force the MT5 Strategy Tester broker engine to close 100% of the position volume at +15.0 pips. This establishes a symmetric 1:1 Risk/Reward ratio ($100 win vs $100 loss), allowing the validated 65.52% win rate from EXP-0053 to generate > +$1,000 net profit on 2026 UNSEEN with drawdown <= 6.0%.

facts: EXP-0053 demonstrated that with InpUseAtrFilter=true and InpMaxAtrPips=20.0, the EA achieved a 65.52% win rate (38 wins vs 20 losses) across 9 months of 2026 UNSEEN data.
In both EXP-0053 and EXP-0055, the largest winning trade never exceeded $118.80 (~17.6 pips), proving that price never once reached the 30-pip TP2 target in 2026.

Because InpTP2Pips=30.0 was never reached, winning trades only captured partial close profits ($37-$42) while losing trades lost -$99.28 on 100% volume, producing an inverted 0.40:1 payout ratio that requires > 71.4% win rate to break even.
inferences: All 38 winning trades in EXP-0053 reached at least +15.0 pips to trigger the TP1 event.
If InpTP2Pips is set to 15.0 pips, MT5 will close 100% of position volume at the 15-pip mark, capturing the full 1:1 reward on every winning trade without leaving runners to erode at breakeven.

independent_variables.name: InpTP2Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Equalizes hard broker Take Profit with the primary 15-pip swing target, closing 100% position volume at 1:1 R:R.

assumptions: MT5 Strategy Tester closes the position fully when Bid/Ask touches InpTP2Pips.
Symmetric 15-pip TP and 15-pip SL provides a true 1:1 risk-reward profile.
expected_observations: Average winning trade payout increases to ~$95-$100.
2026 UNSEEN net profit turns strongly positive (> +$500.00) with profit factor >= 1.40.
falsification_conditions: 2026 UNSEEN net profit remains negative (< $0.00) or profit factor remains < 1.0.
